title: SCS unit schema (source format v3)
description: Validates files under data/schemas/ — the source format. This is NOT the shape of data/dist/v3/ (the build-generated, inheritance-flattened output nobody edits by hand).

attributeType.description: One engine type name. Arrays use the same name plus isArray: true (the engine's own names are <type>_array).

oneOf.description: Text | e.g., key: "text"
Identifier of up to 12 characters from [a-z0-9_] | e.g., key: my_token. SCS files sometimes write it quoted (key: "default").
Floating-point number | e.g., key: 1.5, key: 2 or IEEE 754 hex: &3fc00000
Vector of 2 floats | e.g., key: (x, y)
Vector of 3 floats | e.g., key: (x, y, z)
Vector of 4 floats | e.g., key: (x, y, z, w)
Fixed-point number | e.g., key: 1.5
Vector of 2 fixed-point numbers | e.g., key: (x, y)
Vector of 3 fixed-point numbers | e.g., key: (x, y, z)
Vector of 4 fixed-point numbers | e.g., key: (x, y, z, w)
4x4 matrix of floats. Text syntax not documented on the wiki.
Quaternion rotation | e.g., key: (w; x, y, z)
Position and rotation | e.g., key: (x, y, z) (w; x, y, z)
Placement with a scale. Text syntax not documented on the wiki.
Placement with a non-uniform scale. Text syntax not documented on the wiki.
Geometric plane. Text syntax not documented on the wiki.
Sphere (center and radius). Text syntax not documented on the wiki.
Axis-aligned bounding box. Text syntax not documented on the wiki.
Signed integer | e.g., key: -3
Unsigned integer | e.g., key: 3
Signed 16-bit integer | e.g., key: -3
Unsigned 16-bit integer | e.g., key: 3
Signed 32-bit integer | e.g., key: -3
Unsigned 32-bit integer | e.g., key: 3
Signed 64-bit integer | e.g., key: -3
Unsigned 64-bit integer | e.g., key: 3
Vector of 2 signed integers | e.g., key: (x, y)
Vector of 2 unsigned integers | e.g., key: (x, y)
Boolean | e.g., key: true
One of a fixed list of names, listed in `values` | e.g., key: factory
Unit defined in the same file, usually nameless | e.g., key: .my_mod.unit
Named unit defined anywhere | e.g., key: my.unit.name
Link to a named unit. How it differs from link_ptr is not documented on the wiki.
Path to a resource, typically an animation | e.g., key: "/path/to/file.pma"

versionNote.description: Free-text note on when this was added/removed/changed, as the wiki phrases it (e.g. "Added in 1.38."). null when there's nothing noteworthy. Display-only: the extension never knows the user's game version.

meta.description: Metadata. Must always be present and follow this exact structure.

version.description: Semver version of this schema FILE (not of the game). "0.1.0" on a new file; bumped automatically by scripts/update.mjs — don't edit by hand.

documentationStatus.description: "complete": the class is described. "wip": partly described, or the wiki page carries its own "yet to be reviewed by SCS staff" notice. "undocumented": attribute names and types only, no descriptions yet.

scope.description: The class_name this file documents. The file name is the scope with every "::" written as "." (ui::text_common -> ui.text_common.json).

description.description: What this class is, in a sentence or two. Empty string when not documented yet.

superclass.description: The DIRECT parent class only (scripts/build.mjs resolves the chain). "unit" is the engine's root: no real parent.

allowsSiiNunitRoot.description: false for classes documented as needing to be @include-d instead of used under a file's SiiNunit root (e.g. cargo_data). true for everything else.

key.description: This class's OWN attributes only — inherited ones are merged in by scripts/build.mjs.

description.description: What this attribute does. Empty string when not documented yet.

type.description: The engine type of the value (of each element, when isArray is true).

isArray.description: true if the attribute is an array. Arrays can be written as repeated key[]: value lines, or as key: N followed by key[0]..key[N-1].

values.description: Valid names for an enum attribute, or the documented literals of a token attribute. null otherwise, or when the names aren't known.

pointsTo.description: For owner_ptr / link_ptr / volatile_link_ptr: the class the pointed-to unit is expected to be (subclasses included). null otherwise or when unknown.

status.description: "legacy": the game still accepts the attribute but doesn't use its value (usually replaced by another one). Not suggested in completion and not reported as an error.

default.description: Default value, written as it would appear in a .sii file (e.g. "0", "default", "true"). null when not documented.

expectedExtensions.description: For attributes whose value is a file path: the expected extension(s), without the dot (e.g. ["pmd"]). null when not a file path, unknown, or not a single kind of file.

required.description: true when the documentation marks the attribute as required.

supportsLocalization.description: true if the value supports the @@localization@@ syntax.

internalOnly.description: true for attributes not meant for mods: engine/save-game managed, or used only by SCS (e.g. steam_inventory_id). Hidden from completion.

notes.description: Anything else worth keeping. Empty string when there's nothing to add.
